redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses a distinct material fact (overall profit performance, segment dynamics, geographic performance, margin analysis, cash flow, balance sheet position, strategic focus, working capital changes, personnel statistics, EPS impact) with no substantial overlap.

key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue increased 0.6% to €28.6m with gross profit up 5.3% to €15.9m, but operating profit fell 3.5% to €5.8m and net profit dropped 31.2% to €4.3m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group`s sales amounted to 28 590 thousand EUR during the 06 months of 2026, representing a 0.6% increase... Gross profit during the 06 months of 2026 amounted to 15 892 thousand EUR and increased by 5.3%... Consolidated operating profit for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 3.5%... Reported consolidated net profit for 06 months of 2026 amounted to 4 321 thousand EUR, as compared to net profit of 6 279 thousand EUR...'

key_information_units.information: Retail revenue grew 13.6% to €13.5m representing 47.4% of total, while wholesale revenue declined 9.1% to €14.9m (52.2% of total).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Our retail revenue increased by 13.6% and amounted 13 548 thousand EUR, this represents 47.4% of the Group`s total revenue... Wholesale revenue amounted to 14 934 thousand EUR, representing 52.2% of the Group’s total revenue... during 06 months of 2026 wholesale revenue... decreased by 9.1% compared to 06 months of 2025.'

key_information_units.information: Russia contributed €15.8m (55.1% of sales) flat in EUR but down 7.8% in local currency with store count reducing to 67; Belarus grew 6.4% to €9.0m; Ukraine sales collapsed 58.3% to €15k.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s sales on the Russian market totalled 15 767 thousand EUR, decrease is 0.6% compared to 06 months of 2025... Local currency sales decreased by 7.8%... At the end of the reporting period, there were a total of 67 stores... Belarus... sales... increased by 6.4%... The Group’s sales in Ukraine... decreased by 58.3%...'; Sales by markets table.

key_information_units.information: Gross margin improved to 55.6% (from 53.1%), operating margin fell to 20.1% (from 21.0%), EBITDA margin 26.3% (from 26.6%), and net margin attributable to parent declined to 13.9% (from 20.3%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators table: 'Gross profit margin... 55.6% from 53.1%... Operating profit margin... 20.1% from 21.0%... EBITDA margin... 26.3% from 26.6%... Net profit margin attributable to equity holders of the Parent company... 13.9% against 20.3%...'

key_information_units.information: Operating cash flow surged 96.6% to €6.8m, boosting cash and cash equivalents by 87.4% to €12.4m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators: 'Operating cash flow for the period 6 842 (2025: 3 481)... Cash and cash equivalents 12 443 (2025: 6 639)'; Note 2 Cash and cash equivalents.

key_information_units.information: Total assets grew 5.1% to €98.6m with equity attributable to parent up 6.1% to €81.5m, while current liabilities decreased €1.0m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators: 'Total assets 98 603 (2025: 93 847)... Total equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent company 81 479 (2025: 76 768)... Total current liabilities 8 290 (2025: 9 292)'; Consolidated Statement of Financial Position.

key_information_units.information: Management emphasized improving retail profitability and expanding retail stores in Russia contingent on securing reasonably priced locations.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Russia Economic Outlook: 'Group will focus on improving profitability of its retail business, we will also continue to expand our store chain there depending on the availability of reasonably priced sales areas.'

key_information_units.information: Inventories decreased €1.5m to €29.7m while trade receivables increased €0.8m to €2.2m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 4 Inventories: 'Total 29 702 (2025: 31 237)...'; Note 3 Trade and other receivables: 'Total trade and other receivables 2 175 (2025: 1 329)'; Selected Financial Indicators.

key_information_units.information: Employee count stood at 1,594 (down from 1,639) with total salaries and related taxes rising to €8.8m from €7.9m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Personnel section: 'As of 30 June 2026, the Group employed 1 594 people... Total salaries and related taxes during 06 months of 2026 amounted 8 838 thousand EUR (2025: 7 885 thousand EUR).'

key_information_units.information: Earnings per share declined to €0.11 from €0.16, a 31.3% decrease.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Financial Indicators: 'Earnings per share (EUR) 0,11 (2025: 0,16)...'; Note 8 Earnings per share.
